world: World: Shatterline Crossing, the crossing where the city broke and curses walk; cracked dark asphalt, purple glowing curse cracks, broken debris; dark purple and white colours.
ground: cracked dark purple-grey asphalt with fine grain, a network of thin cracks, small rubble bits and a few thin faintly glowing purple cracks.
low: a sunken broken road: shattered dark asphalt chunks and gravel with small glowing purple cracks between them; darker than the asphalt around it.
high: an intact raised road deck: smoother lighter grey asphalt with fine grain, small white paint flecks and tiny cracks; brighter than the broken road below.
trail: a worn crossing surface: pale grey concrete with fine grit, small chips and faint scuffs, no stripes or lines.
cliff: a broken road edge: a jagged asphalt lip along the top edge; below it, a cross-section of road layers, grey concrete and gravel with bits of bent rebar and thin glowing purple cracks.
